'''Wordro's organization''', run by [[Wordro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], suffered hijackings of its shipments during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Hijacker Ambush" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> an individual associated with one of the two opposing governments sent a companion of theirs to guard the organization's shipments in exchange for Wordro giving them a share of his profits. The companion defeated the hijackers and exposed a [[Unidentified traitor (Wordro's organization)|traitor]] working within Wordo's organization. The Hutt was pleased and gave them a bonus.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Wordro the Hutt's organization was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Hijacker Ambush" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The information regarding the mission's completion was later removed from the game.<ref name="TOR" />
